global_style: Highly stylized, neon-lit comic book aesthetic with halftone textures, bold contrasts, kinetic motion blur, and shifting frame rates; dynamic camera, including 180-degree inversion to dramatize the leap of faith.

project_settings.location_lock: New York City, USA (NOT Los Angeles, NOT Tokyo)

style_overrides.color_palette: Neon blues, magentas, cyans; high-contrast blacks
style_overrides.cinematography: Comic-book framing, halftone textures, extreme angles, 180-degree inversion
style_overrides.frame_rate: Variable frame rates to emphasize emotion and motion

key_events: A young superhero stands at the extreme edge of a New York skyscraper.
He falls backward into the neon-lit abyss of the city.
The camera violently inverts 180°, creating the illusion of rising into the sky.
He spreads his arms, embracing a leap of faith as shattering glass sounds echo.
narrative_context.cultural_context: Superhero genre; urban New York skyline; stylized comic-book/animation language using halftones, bold neon, and variable frame rates.

characters.name: Young Superhero
characters.description: Young masked hero at skyscraper edge; athletic build; wears black suit under a green jacket, red-and-blue sneakers; poised for a backward fall; silhouetted against neon city glow.
characters.clothing_style: Black suit beneath bright green jacket; red-and-blue high-top sneakers; urban streetwear meets superhero stealth.
characters.voice_description: Youthful, grounded, urban cadence; breathy with exertion; determined yet vulnerable; minimal dialogue.
characters.personality: Courageous, conflicted, introspective, resilient; embracing risk to grow.
characters.backstory: A newly emerging hero confronting fear and self-doubt, learning to trust instinct and take a leap toward identity.
characters.current_motivation: Commit to the superhero path by trusting the fall and embracing the leap of faith.

locations.narrative_function: Turning-point platform for leap of faith.
